# econstruct, Inc.

> econstruct, Inc. is a Los Angeles design-build general contractor (CA License #964015) constructing exceptional spaces to live, work, shop and eat. Headquartered in Valencia, CA, the firm delivers commercial build-outs — restaurants, bars, retail, offices, food distribution and cold storage — plus luxury custom homes, fire rebuilds and residential remodels across Los Angeles County. 634 completed projects and 51 years of combined leadership experience.

Key facts:
- License: California General Contractor #964015 (CSLB)
- Phone: 310.740.9999 · Email: info@econstructinc.com
- Address: 25350 Magic Mountain Pkwy, Suite 300, Valencia, CA 91355
- Service area: Los Angeles County — Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Malibu, Pacific Palisades, Calabasas, Altadena and surrounding communities

## Services

- [All Services](https://econstructinc.com/services): Overview of commercial and residential construction services
- [Restaurant & Bar Construction](https://econstructinc.com/services/restaurant-bar-construction): Full hospitality build-outs — kitchens, hoods, bars and MEP coordination
- [Retail Tenant Improvement](https://econstructinc.com/services/retail-tenant-improvement): Storefronts, custom millwork and brand-perfect retail fit-outs
- [Office Tenant Improvement](https://econstructinc.com/services/office-tenant-improvement): Office and creative workplace TI with permit support
- [Food Distribution & Cold Storage Construction](https://econstructinc.com/food-distribution-construction): Distribution centers, cold storage, commissary and ghost kitchens, food manufacturing
- [Fire Rebuild Contractor](https://econstructinc.com/services/fire-rebuild-contractor-los-angeles): Wildfire rebuild construction including Palisades and Eaton fire recovery
- [Custom Home Construction](https://econstructinc.com/services/custom-home-construction-los-angeles): Ground-up custom homes in Los Angeles
- [Luxury Home Builder](https://econstructinc.com/services/luxury-home-builder-los-angeles): High-end remodels and luxury modernization
- [Home Additions](https://econstructinc.com/services/home-additions-los-angeles): Additions and accessory dwelling units (ADUs)
